list.title: Occasions you run
list.emptyBody: Create the first occasion for a client below. The whole team sees it and can work in it.
list.emptyBodyNoCreate: The occasions the business runs for clients appear here.

create.title: New occasion for a client
create.name: Occasion name
create.dateHint: You can leave it empty and set it later.
create.lapsed: The business plan has lapsed: existing occasions carry on, but new ones cannot be created.
create.notActive: The business is restricted, so nothing can be changed here for now.

handedOver.title: Handed over to clients
handedOver.body: After a handover the occasion belongs to the client. The business keeps only this record.

grants.title: What the team sees in the business's occasions
grants.body: Every team member works in the business's occasions as an organiser. You choose whether they also see the money and guests' private requests.
grants.privateRequestsHint: For example allergies or access needs.

apply.title: Apply from the library
apply.emptyBody: Add task templates, checklists or suppliers to the library, then apply them here.
apply.itemHint: We first show what would be added. Nothing changes until you confirm.

files.title: Files shared with the occasion
files.body: Shared files can be opened by every member of the occasion and stay with them after the handover.
files.shared: The file is now visible in the occasion.
files.none: No files shared yet. Add files to the library and you can share them from here.
files.lapsed: The business plan has lapsed: files already shared stay, but no more can be shared.

handover.title: Hand the occasion over to the client
handover.body: When the event becomes the client's, you hand the occasion over. This is what happens:
handover.ends1: The chosen client becomes the owner of the occasion, with access to the budget and private requests.
handover.ends2: The whole team's access ends, and so do the business's assistant connections.
handover.ends3: The business's name, logo and colour disappear from guest pages.
handover.stays: The plan stays whole: tasks, guests, suppliers, money and shared files.
handover.noClientTitle: The client is not in the occasion yet
handover.noClientBody: Invite the client as a member of the occasion. Once they accept, you can choose them here.
handover.freshTitle: A handover needs you to confirm it is you
handover.freshBody: You can see what changes, but applying it needs a recent confirmation.
handover.toHint: Only members of the occasion who are not on the business team.

about.template: A template is a list of tasks you apply to an occasion. Each task gets its due date worked out from the event date.
about.checklist: In an occasion, a checklist becomes one task with its steps.
about.contact: Suppliers you work with often. Applied to an occasion, a contact appears in its supplier list.
about.asset: Images or PDFs you share with occasions: floor plans, menus, standard offers.

library.emptyBody: Add the first item below. The whole team will be able to use it.
library.lapsed: The business plan has lapsed: the library can still be read and applied, but no longer changed.
library.archiveHint: What was already applied or shared stays in the occasions.

linesHint.template: For a due date, end the line with “; ” and the number of months before the event. Example: “Choose the venue; 6”.

branding.title: How guests see you
branding.body: Your name, logo and one accent colour appear on the guest pages of the occasions you run, until each occasion is handed over.
branding.staffOnly: Branding can be changed by the owner or an admin.
branding.lapsed: The business plan has lapsed: the chosen branding stays on guest pages, but can no longer be changed.
branding.name: Name shown to guests
branding.nameHint: If you leave it empty, “{name}” is shown.
branding.previewLabel: How it looks on a guest's page
branding.previewLink: See the venue on the map

banner.title: Occasion run by {business}
banner.team: You work here as a member of the team, with organiser rights.
banner.client: The business's team has organiser access until the occasion is handed over to you.
banner.joinHint: So that tasks can be assigned to you.

reports.title: The business's occasions
reports.inWorkNote: of {total} in total, including those handed over
reports.upcomingEmpty: No occasion with a set date in the coming period.
reports.assetUseBody: Daily totals. Who used what is not kept.
reports.assetUseEmpty: Nothing from the library was used in this period.

whatif.alreadyThere: Already in the plan, left unchanged: {count}
whatif.branding: The business's branding on guest pages
whatif.planStays: Tasks, guests, suppliers, money, shared files

errors.accentFormat: Choose a colour from the picker.
errors.logoInvalid: The logo must be an image uploaded by the business.
errors.tooManyLines: There are too many lines. Split them into two items.
errors.libraryFull: The library has reached its limit. Remove an item to add another.
errors.handoverTarget: Choose a member of the occasion who is not on the business team.
